question: Why can parents not revoke Settings (401) in UntisX (endpoint /notifications)?
answer: Check role parents. Module Settings may require higher permissions. Error 401: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /notifications and the database connection. Feature Settings must be enabled.
